svg.aria-label: Saif Ali, saifdev9, Kolkata. Lead front-end developer && Jr. DevOps engineer at Indiminds. The two roles run as a shell chain: front-end, exit 0, && devops, exit 0. cat about: The command after && only runs when the one before it exits clean. Same rule at work: the interface has to hold before anything ships.
